audit_items.proof_trace: All three concrete implementations (LegionCapitalRaise, LegionAbstractSale, LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale) call _verifyTransferSignature as the first operation, passing the stored legionSigner. The shared internal function uses ECDSA.recover on a message bound to (from, to, positionId, msg.sender, address(this), chainid) and reverts if recovered != legionSigner. No concrete override omits this call and no alternative construction path bypasses it.
